label: Faulty gate records
subgoals: Store the good gate's input and output values
Keep a record only for faults whose values differ at the gate
Delete records that converge back to the good values

label: Divergence and scheduling
subgoals: Evaluate each faulty copy's output from its input values
Compare it with the good gate's output
Schedule only the diverging copies at the fanout gates

label: Where it fits
subgoals: Carry diverged state records into the next clock cycle
Mark a fault detected when its record differs at an output
Prefer bit-parallel PPSFP for full-scan combinational problems
